why: Two rounds going out together. The SAFETY round is almost entirely invisible: thirteen older additive migrations become all-or-nothing (no result change, proved by a full iterdump comparison of a fresh install built both ways), a standing lockstep check over the migrations and the corpus passes, the baseline catch-up compares every column it writes, three passes stop deleting waits and storage from a baseline they rewrite, owner filters on the ingredient list and the seasonal list, one shared has-an-image helper, the suite's per-run marker now asks the session's own connection instead of a path, and an app-created recipe records its notes in recipe_notes_original the way an imported one does. The TIME BLOCK round is the one visible change: the block above the ingredients reads in two columns when it has waits, the scaler moves below it, and a conditional second total reads "if you soak". The one database change is migration 063, which drops the retired recipes.notes column. That column has been a derived copy since migration 060, it is outside recipe_snapshots.content, and nothing reads it: the notes themselves are recipe_notes rows and the author's words are in recipe_notes_original. Measured on live read-only: 300 recipes, 95 carrying note rows, 95 carrying originals, and 19 whose derived column no longer agreed with their rows. No row changes, so the byte-equal set and the annotation set both hold still. Three later changes from Andy's click-through: the time block reads in ONE fixed order everywhere (times, Serves, Plan ahead, Keeps); a stated total that is shorter than the waits that always apply has those waits added to it and keeps the author's own figure on a line below, which is 1 recipe of the 300 (earl-grey-tea-cake); and one unreferenced photo is deleted, declared below. The totals change is display only and writes nothing: the rule is planahead.stated_total_verdict, computed at display like every other total.

files.why: The only unreferenced file in the photo library besides README.txt. 119,394 bytes, 768 x 1024, created 2026-07-31 11:42, and byte-identical to adventist-gumbo.jpg, which IS referenced (cook_photos.path). So its name is one recipe and its content is another recipe's cook photo. The cauliflower recipe has image NULL in live and in all 12 backups, the oldest from 2026-09-29, and no backup references the file.
